title: Webb finds a surprising atmosphere on a scorching lava world
caption:
The James Webb Space Telescope has detected an atmosphere on a scorching lava world called HD 3167 b. Despite being blasted by stellar winds, this rocky planet is cooler than expected, suggesting it has a protective layer of gas. This discovery helps scientists model how early Earth might have looked during its own molten magma phase.

Source: Sciencedaily - Webb finds a surprising atmosphere on a scorching lava world
